claims: C1 facilitating a critical or high severity harm is forbidden
C2 the listed harms (violence, weapons, terrorism, child abuse, persecution, mass surveillance) are instances of critical or high severity harms

concepts.name: critical_or_high_severity_harm
concepts.gloss: H is a harm of critical or high severity, as the clause's examples illustrate

concepts.name: act_of_violence
concepts.gloss: H is an act of violence, such as crimes against humanity, war crimes, genocide, torture, human trafficking or forced labor

concepts.name: weapons_creation
concepts.gloss: H is the creation of cyber, biological or nuclear weapons, such as weapons of mass destruction

concepts.name: terrorism
concepts.gloss: H is an act of terrorism

concepts.name: child_abuse
concepts.gloss: H is child abuse, such as the creation of CSAM

concepts.name: persecution
concepts.gloss: H is the act of persecuting individuals or groups, often on political, religious, or ethnic grounds

concepts.name: mass_surveillance
concepts.gloss: H is the systematic surveillance of a large population, typically by a state or authority

ontology.gloss: an act of violence is a critical or high severity harm
creation of cyber, biological or nuclear weapons is a critical or high severity harm
terrorism is a critical or high severity harm
child abuse is a critical or high severity harm
persecution is a critical or high severity harm
mass surveillance is a critical or high severity harm

asserts.read_back: facilitating % is forbidden because % is a critical or high severity harm

closure.reason: the clause forbids facilitating critical or high severity harms only; facilitating anything else is not addressed and so remains permitted
